policy: Every tracked binary is declared here, from anywhere in the tree including the research zones. Trailmap/tools/specs/repo_hygiene.py fails when a tracked binary is missing an entry and when an entry names a file that is no longer tracked, so this list cannot silently drift out of date. It also fails on any tracked file whose type it does not recognise, so a format nobody thought to list cannot slip past by being invisible to both halves of the check. A line says what the file is, how it was made, and whether anything in it came from somewhere else.
notes: No retail game files or extracted assets are distributed here. The website's documentation screenshots depict the editor, including locally imported reference courses, and one third-party modeling application. Those screenshots are identified individually below; they are not game-data bundles.
The 19 prop GLBs each rebuild from a checked-in recipe under Slopesmith/tools/prop-recipes/; the recipe is the source of truth and the GLB is committed only so a fresh clone does not need Blender.

The four generated characters work the same way, from checked-in TypeScript under Slopesmith/tools/character-models/: a bone table, a table of solids and a short palette. Their checks regenerate each model and assert the tracked GLB is byte-identical, so none can drift from the source that produced it. The two emissive masks each carried by Alpine Exo and Servo Scout are written by code as functions of (u, v) rather than being authored or sourced images, and are PNG-encoded in-repo without a compressor so the bytes are the same on every platform.
The brand mark was designed and drawn by the project author. Its master source and generated derivatives are original project artwork.
